x: Ray Tooby, our new member from Dartford, was first home with Mike Stearman second and Maclean third. J.
Adams just behind him and then two of our younger members in Harry Greene and J.

Mike Stearman was third in last year's race but owing to illness has not been able to do much training this season, and he was rather disappointed with his present position. However, our boys packed splendidly, which is the main thing to remember in cross-country running, and with Harry Greene 10th, J.
Connelly, a new member, was our next runner, and he dropped another pace but we were still near the leaders and doing as well as we had expected. J.

This was held at the White City on June 14th and in the Junior events, Alan Picton won the 100 yards and also the 440 yards while Alan Law was second in the 220 yards. Ray Tooby won the mile in the good time of 4 mins. 34.4 secs. with J.
There were some Junior events on the programme and in these Gerry Trower was fourth in the 880, and in the 1 mile which was run in two sections, J.
Brooks, who ran far above any previous form, and Tom Morrell gained second place, with J.
L. A. Adams · 19.16 · J. E. Godfrey · 21.28

This match was held in conjunction with the " Gordon Stewart " Trophy contest at Drayton Green, and our juniors once again came out on top. Frank Kemp won the 100 yards, with Alan Law taking the 220, and Doug Maclean won the half-mile, with J.
At the “News of the World” ground on June 6th, this was not too well supported by our senior members, but we managed to win the junior match. J.
